correctness.rationale: For positive and constant per-good value, agent inter-EF1 for every ordered pair is equivalent to maximum minus minimum assigned count at most 1. Hence counts consist of q and q+1 with exactly r larger counts, m=4q+r. Item-based realized center EF1, under exact published definitions, gives a+b>=c+d-1 and c+epsilon*d>=a+b-1. Exhausting each residue r=0,1,2,3 forces canonical count patterns (q,q|q,q), (q,q|q+1,q), (q,q+1|q+1,q), (q,q+1|q+1,q+1). The remaining center inequality gives inclusive thresholds (q-1)/q, max(0,(q-2)/q), (q-1)/q, (q-1)/(q+1). Every allowed epsilon supplies an explicit allocation, and excluded patterns require epsilon>=1 or violate center-1 fairness. Independent exact enumeration verified 1,748 parameter/inventory pairs for 4<=m<=200 and m=8,9,10 reversal; infinite range is covered by four-case proof.
residual_risks: Only identical positive goods and item-based realized center semantics; not general delegated fair division.
